implementation_constraints: Reads entire stdin as JSON array in one pass
State persists across all requests in one input array
Each new process run starts with empty state
ID counter is monotonic and never reset (1, 2, 3...), even after deletion
Response array order matches request array order exactly
Single bad request does not abort batch processing

unresolved_intent.rationale: Path segment parsing errors are resource-not-found (404), not bad-request (400), following REST convention where invalid resource identifiers indicate the path does not resolve to a valid resource
The path /items/<id> is a defined route; an unsupported method on a defined path yields 405 (method not allowed), distinct from 404 (path not found), per AC-RH-04

GET /items returns items in creation order; storing only in id-to-item dict would lose order information for deleted items. A separate list preserves insertion order while allowing O(1) id lookup and deletion
Per AC-RH-05 and INV-RH-IDS-01, a POST/PUT with malformed body returns 400 but does not stop batch processing. Each request is independent; responses are always in request order
